name: Virgin Hotels Edinburgh
positioning: Playful, design-led hotel on Victoria Street in Edinburgh's Old Town, just off the Royal Mile
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Edinburgh Castle and the Old Town

facts.text: The hotel is in Edinburgh's Old Town, just off the Royal Mile.
The hotel is at 1 India Buildings on Victoria Street.
From the hotel's red door, guests can stroll down Victoria Street or walk to explore Edinburgh Castle.
Rooms have SMEG fridges stocked at street prices.
A yoga mat is available in every chamber.
Rooms have a dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area with flattering lights.
Suites come with a complimentary mini-bar.
The Scottish Table serves ten dishes across three courses of seasonal Scottish ingredients in the intimate Commons Club Kitchen, for up to 10 people at a time.
Eve is the hotel's Italian restaurant and bar.
The hotel is dog friendly, and pets stay free.
The hotel has a gym and fitness centre.
The Virgin Hotels app connects guests' phones to the chamber controls and hotel staff.

highlights.text: The Oculus Lounge is an elegant circular lounge below a historic cupola.
Some rooms have views of Edinburgh Castle.
Rooms with a balcony look out over Edinburgh's Old Town.
In the rooms, discreet partitions separate the sleeping quarters from the dressing room.

considerations.text: From the Princes Street tram stop, it is a short walk up a big hill to the hotel.
The hotel is about 30 minutes from the airport.
WhataHotel notes a busy central location with potential street noise.
